name: USGS ScienceBase Catalog API
description: ScienceBase is a collaborative scientific data and information management platform used by the USGS and partners. The catalog API provides RESTful access to search, read, and manage scientific data items with support for full-text search, spatial queries, and hierarchical browsing.
